name: A real healthy whole blood (GSM7508429)
about: Every site of IAM-Atlas v2.1 has one fixed place on this globe, the same as on the atlas's cell pages. Drag to turn it. The healthy reference is healthy blood for this person's own cell mix (IAM-Atlas v2.1, Stage D21 shares); the difference is shown at 773,556 sites. Choose the smallest difference to show: everything smaller fades into the reference's own grey, so only the larger differences stay lit. A picture: nothing is scored from it; Met-A and the C-Score read against their own commissioned reference, which is also a layer. The atlas blends 21 sources and sits slightly closer to 0.5 than one array, so a healthy sample shows a faint even difference. In a woman one X chromosome is held methylated, so her X shows as a patch against a reference that pools both sexes. A small loss spread over many sites shows on the departures layer, not the whole genome.
